meaning:
§ Kabzeel = "God gathers"
the most remote city of Judah; located in southern Judah on the border of Edom

elsewhere.note: The farthest cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the border of Edom in the South were Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,
